name: PumpToken public removeLiquidityWhenKIncreases burns pair tokens and syncs
summary: LAURA is a clone of the PumpToken template, whose public removeLiquidityWhenKIncreases() deducts tokenReserve*(currentK-INITIAL_K)/currentK from the pair's LAURA balance and syncs whenever the pair's K exceeds 105% of its initial value. The attacker added liquidity to raise K, called the function to strip most of the pair's LAURA, and swapped a little LAURA for the pair's WETH.
notes: Reset is the clone's creation (rule 9). The factory 0xd1bd232f's four other PumpToken clones' pairs held at most 0.41 ETH at the anchor; the attacker hit no other clone.
